title: [Bug]: LLMConfig.where does not maintain properties other than config_list
body:
### Describe the bug

`LLMConfig` supports other properties according to both docs and code base:
https://github.com/ag2ai/ag2/blob/7aea2adf4399bab7af32a82aeea5f57f62e3ed39/autogen/llm_config.py#L250-L270

These properties are lost after calling `where`.
 
https://github.com/ag2ai/ag2/blob/7aea2adf4399bab7af32a82aeea5f57f62e3ed39/autogen/llm_config.py#L134-L141

### Steps to reproduce

See description.

### Model Used

N/A

### Expected Behavior

All properties should be maintained.

### Screenshots and logs

See description.

### Additional Information

main
